proceedings.supporting_quote: On 20 November 2000, the court declared the applicant partially incapacitated (rather than totally), finding that while his ability to manage his affairs was impaired due to schizophrenia, his condition was not serious enough to warrant total incapacity.
This judgment was upheld by the Veliko Tarnovo Court of Appeal on 12 April 2001.
The regional prosecutor refused to bring the action on 10 August 2005, citing medical opinions and the view of the social care home that the applicant was unable to cope on his own.
This refusal was upheld by the appellate prosecutor (11 October 2005)

proceedings.deciding_body: Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation
proceedings.supporting_quote: and the Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office at the Supreme Court of Cassation (29 November 2005).
On 10 March 2006, the court dismissed the application.
